title: Enriched RAN Anomaly (ran-anomalies-enriched topic)
description: Schema for enriched anomaly records published to the ran-anomalies-enriched Kafka topic by the ran-rca-service after LLM-powered root cause analysis.

cell_id.description: Numeric identifier of the RAN cell that produced the anomaly

band.description: Frequency band of the cell (e.g. Band 29)

anomaly_type.description: Classification of the anomaly (e.g. LowRsrp, SinrDegradation)

anomaly.description: Human-readable description of the detected anomaly

root_cause.description: LLM-determined root cause of the anomaly
